stories.title: The Troubles
stories.subtitle: Northern Ireland, 1966–1998
stories.blurb: Civil rights marches, the Provisional IRA, loyalist paramilitaries and the long road to the Good Friday Agreement.

stories.title: Rome v Carthage
stories.subtitle: The Punic Wars, 264–146 BC
stories.blurb: Three wars for the western Mediterranean: Hannibal's elephants, the slaughter at Cannae and the burning of Carthage.

stories.title: Rise and fall of Rome
stories.subtitle: 753 BC – AD 476
stories.blurb: From a hill town on the Tiber to an empire from Scotland to the Persian Gulf, and its slow collapse in the west.

stories.title: Cortés and the Aztecs
stories.subtitle: The fall of Tenochtitlan, 1519–1521
stories.blurb: A few hundred Spaniards, thousands of native allies and smallpox bring down the greatest city in the Americas.

stories.title: Second World War in Europe
stories.blurb: Blitzkrieg, the Battle of Britain, Barbarossa, D-Day and the fall of Berlin.

stories.title: The American Revolution
stories.blurb: From the Stamp Act riots to Yorktown: thirteen colonies break with Britain, and a colonial revolt becomes a world war.

stories.title: The American Civil War
stories.blurb: Secession, Fort Sumter, Antietam and emancipation, Gettysburg and Vicksburg, Sherman's march and Appomattox: the war that saved the Union and ended slavery.

stories.title: The French Revolution and Napoleon
stories.blurb: The Bastille, the Terror and the guillotine, then Napoleon's empire from Madrid to Moscow, and its fall at Waterloo.

stories.title: The Crusades
stories.blurb: From Clermont to the fall of Acre: the crusader states, Saladin and Hattin, the sack of Constantinople, and the Mamluks who ended it all.

stories.title: The First World War
stories.subtitle: 1914–1918, and the peace of 1919
stories.blurb: Sarajevo, the Marne, Gallipoli, Verdun and the Somme, revolution in Russia, the Hundred Days and the new map of Europe.

stories.title: The Cold War
stories.blurb: The Iron Curtain, the Berlin Airlift, Korea, Cuba and Vietnam, proxy wars from Angola to Afghanistan, and the fall of the Wall.

stories.title: The Iranian Revolution
stories.blurb: Oil nationalised, a coup, the Shah's White Revolution, the marches of 1978, Khomeini's return, the hostage crisis and Iraq's invasion.

cities.name: Rome
cities.blurb: Temples, forums, the Colosseum and twenty thousand houses on the seven hills. Scrub from the kings to the Aurelian Walls.

cities.name: Carthage
cities.blurb: The Punic city with its circular naval harbour, then Scipio's siege, the ruins, and the Roman city built on top.

cities.name: Tenochtitlan
cities.blurb: The Aztec capital on its lake: causeways, canals, chinampa gardens and the Templo Mayor, and its destruction in 1521.

cities.name: Paris
cities.blurb: The city of the Revolution: the Bastille, the Tuileries, the guillotine on the Place de la Révolution and the new customs wall.

cities.name: Jerusalem
cities.blurb: The walled city under crusader rule: the Holy Sepulchre, the Dome of the Rock as the Templum Domini, the Templars on the Temple Mount, and the sieges of 1099 and 1187.

cities.name: Berlin
cities.blurb: The four sectors, the Airlift's Tempelhof, the Wall and its death strip, Checkpoint Charlie and the Brandenburg Gate, 1945–1990.

cities.name: Tehran
cities.blurb: The city of the revolution: the avenues of the great marches, Jaleh Square, the university, the bazaar, the palaces, Evin prison and the US embassy.
